richiami.difetto: A steel clip which secures an interior heater pipe has a rubber sleeve bonded to it which protects it against chafing on it's carrier bracket. On a small number of vehicles this sleeve has moved causing the bracket to cut into the heater pipe with subsequent loss of coolant
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the piping checked and replaced together with the carrier bracket as necessary.

richiami.difetto: It has been established that under certain circumstances the roof locks may be subject to incorrect operation which may lead to the roof becoming insecure
richiami.modello: ELCB DEMOUNTABLE UPPERDECK DOUBLE/DECKER , ELCB DEMOUNTABLE UPPERDECK DOUBLE/DECKER
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a modified roof locking system.
